title: "[RFC] "

## RFC: [Title]

> This is an RFC (Request for Comments). Implementation should not begin until this RFC is accepted by a maintainer.

## Summary

One paragraph describing the change.

## Motivation

Why is this change necessary? What problems does it solve?

## Detailed Design

A thorough technical description. Include:
- Proposed IR changes (if any)
- API changes
- Plugin API impact
- Migration path for existing users

## Core / Plugin Boundary Impact

Does this change what the core owns vs. what plugins can access? How?

## Drawbacks

What are the downsides of this approach?

## Alternatives

What other designs were considered and why were they rejected?

## Unresolved Questions

What open questions need to be resolved before this RFC can be accepted?
